intent: 2BR / 1 bath, LD style — OVERSIZED-LOT fixture, no carport. A 15x15 lot is far larger than a 2BR program needs: the raw buildable shell is 11 x 10 = 110 m2 against a summed preferred-high target of ~98 m2, so this brief exists specifically to exercise BUILDABLE-SHELL CAPPING (SHELL_CAPPING_DESIGN.md §2) — expect the setbacks to inflate (front toward its 4.5 m cap, sides growing equally) rather than the rooms sprawling to fill the envelope. Note the 2-bath squarish 2BR topologies are all INFEASIBLE at 15x15 (above their feasible band, capped or not), which is why this uses the single-bath ld topology. Added 2026-08-05; the suite previously had only one brief above the capping threshold.
